hypothesis: Context-dependent correction can recover candidate errors that a global score transformation cannot.
features: Existing five score features interact with a fixed 16-dimensional random projection of causal pre-draft context; retain v90 shared/position score features.
screen: Exposed v89 even/odd prompt split, internal three request-grouped folds on even prompts select penalty; native fallback wins ties.
gate: At least 10% replay reward versus native and prefix exceeds CE before collecting independent data. This gate is necessary, not sufficient: goal requires serving speed against strong controls.
limitations: Contextual candidate correction is prior art
A positive screen alone does not justify novelty or speed claims
